# VO Apps

> MirrorVO, LayoutVO and more. Simple iPhone apps that make everyday tasks easier.

## Apps

- [MirrorVO](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6799552665): Mirror your iPhone screen to your TV. Games, videos, photos or slides: mirrors your iPhone screen wirelessly to Chromecast-enabled TVs. No cables, no setup.
- [LayoutVO](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6818802118): Plan your room in 3D, place furniture. Enter your room size, drag and drop furniture, walk through it in 3D and see it in your room with AR. AI turns your plan into a realistic photo.
- [StageVO](https://ozvey07-byte.github.io/en/#stagevo) (coming soon): See it in your room before you buy. Places a photo of a vase, rug or lamp into a photo of your own room. The product stays exactly as it is; shadow and light adapt to your room. Everything runs on your phone.
- [CallVO](https://ozvey07-byte.github.io/en/#callvo) (coming soon): Turn conversations into text. Transcribes recordings right on your phone and exports them as Word and PDF. No servers: audio and text never leave your phone.
